findings.title: The placed record makes every act present
findings.claim: The placed record turns completed intentional acts into present objects before the people who performed them, with its accounting range spanning both the small and the great.
findings.mechanism: The passive placement carries the book into view; the writing and binding senses of the book meet the small-and-great merism, exhaustive counting, finding, and presentness. The criminal label and apprehensive response attach this exposed evidence to the subjects rather than to an abstract archive.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the verse's record as an encounter in which each act is brought before its actor, not merely as a statement that information was stored.
findings.containment: The ordinary judgment scene remains intact. This finding does not specify a physical format for the book, turn every consequence into immediate punishment, or claim that the lexical pressure replaces the verse's plain accounting statement.

epistemic.reason: The candidate's citable supports and branch nomination are trusted, and every retained semantic relation lands on exact focus words and facets.

findings.containment: The focus remains a complete record before a later consequence. The attributed trace leaves open the alternative that the repeated verbs are narrative parallel rather than a causal mediation by the book.

findings.mechanism: 18:57 supplies forgetting, forwarding, and embodied hand-deeds; the focus supplies exhaustive counting, finding, and presentness. The exact contact turns the record into an external counter-memory against subjective erasure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the deeds are found rather than merely remembered: the record returns what the actor no longer holds in memory as something present before them.
findings.containment: The focus still states judicial proof of completed deeds. The attributed trace leaves open the alternative that presentness serves proof without a specifically mnemonic function.

epistemic.reason: The exact 18:57 word-index trace and focus returns support the relation, while the reader identity is legacy_unbound and the three context branch records lack independent lexicon detail.

findings.title: Complete accounting and bounded timing
findings.claim: Complete evidence can coexist with merciful suspension and a fixed appointment, so the focus's justice relation concerns both what is accounted and when consequence is allowed to arrive.
findings.mechanism: 18:58 places forgiveness and mercy beside an explicitly unrealized acceleration and an appointed term. Those context roles meet the focus Lord, no-wronging, and exhaustive-count carriers, separating evidentiary completeness from automatic immediate execution.
findings.reader_payoff: The final no-wronging statement becomes sensitive to timing as well as accuracy: precision includes a measured arrival of consequence.
findings.containment: The focus's ordinary denial of wrong remains intact. The attributed trace leaves open the alternative that mercy only postpones an unchanged sentence and does not itself alter the function of no-wronging.

epistemic.reason: The exact 18:58 context occurrences, focus returns, and before/after relation are supplied, but reader identity is legacy_unbound and most context branch records have no independent lexicon detail.

branch_activations.carrier: Forgiving protection supplies suspended consequence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Mercy supplies the non-punitive relation alongside forgiveness.
branch_activations.activation: Forgiveness and mercy meet the focus's complete account and show that evidence does not automatically become immediate punishment.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The record can be complete while consequence remains bounded by a merciful interval.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is attributed without an independent gloss or facet, and no claim is made that forgiveness erases the record.

branch_activations.carrier: Merciful tenderness supplies the non-punitive relation after the record's precision.
